name: Apatura DC Project 5 Ltd
notes: Named as applicant for P/26/0237/FUL in press reporting of the application; company number not verified against Companies House in this session.

name: Apatura
ownership_summary: Scottish renewable energy and data centre developer; states 1.6GW+ of confirmed grid connections across its pipeline. CEO Giles Hanglin.

name: Scottish Enterprise
ownership_summary: Scotland's national economic development agency; reported owner of the ~55-acre Glenbervie site, which is allocated for business and industry use. A Scottish Enterprise spokesperson (Victoria Carmichael) welcomed the proposal's 'ambition and scale'. Transaction terms with Apatura not disclosed.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: Lodged formal objection arguing the proposal is contrary to the development plan and environmental information is inadequate; calls for a moratorium on hyperscale AI data centres in Scotland.

name: Say No To Larbert Data Centre
notes: Resident-organised campaign (Facebook group); organised public meeting on 25 June 2026 and objection drives.

name: Stop Climate Chaos Scotland
notes: Reported among groups raising concerns about the proposal.
